entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd love to go for a walk[n]on the beach. We're in[n]Hawaii, after all.
entries.uk: Я б залюбки прогулялася[n]пляжем. Ми ж таки[n]на Гаваях.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can finally take a[n]break from my job too...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If you don't have any[n]plans, would you like[n]to take a walk with me?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Should I wear a swimsuit...?[n]Well, see you later!
